results.rationale: Consistency: Excluding the toe-count correction, the turquoise sandal remains but its strap contour and sole proportions change; the wet-ground reflections and background light positions also change. Instruction: Seven toes become five. A successful correction would give five anatomically plausible toes; the count is corrected, but the large toe has an unnatural rounded, nail-less end, so correction is partial. Quality: Structural coherence ✘ at the bulbous big toe and absent visible nail; natural lighting ✔, artifact-free background ✔, and skin, strap and pavement textures ✔.

Consistency: The white background and brown-cover/yellow-page appearance remain. The originally thick left book is made thin, and the right book becomes visibly wider, both beyond the requested thickness increase of the thin book. Instruction: The right book becomes thick while the left becomes thin. Expected are two books of matching thickness; the intended right book is thickened, but the pair still has sharply unequal thicknesses, giving partial compliance. Quality: Structural coherence ✔ for both closed books, natural perspective ✔, artifact-free ✔, and cover/page textures ✔; moderate softness does not obscure their forms.
